constraints.constraint: Forecast accuracy must meet ±15% MAPE threshold on key indicators
Insight relevance target: 75%+ rated useful/actionable by user testing
Recommendation alignment target: 80%+ with expert analysis
New code must have ≥80% test coverage (CI/CD enforced)
Use tests/validation/ directory for validation tests (separate from unit/integration)
Minimum 8 data points required for reliable forecasting (MIN_DATA_POINTS)
Unit tests mock external dependencies (Mistral LLM, Qdrant)
Google-style docstrings on all public functions
Type hints on all function signatures

tests.standards: Testing follows pytest patterns with pytest-asyncio for async tests. Unit tests mock external dependencies (Mistral LLM for synthesis). Coverage target ≥80% for new code. Validation tests use expert-labeled ground truth scenarios with binary pass/fail criteria. Use @pytest.mark.validation marker for CI/CD control. Test database runs on port 6335 (Qdrant) and 5433 (PostgreSQL).

ideas.idea: Test MAPE calculation with known inputs: actuals=[100,110,120], predictions=[105,115,125] → MAPE~4.5%
Test backtesting workflow: 12-point series with 80/20 split, validate holdout MAPE
Test revenue forecast: synthetic growth data (5% QoQ), validate MAPE ≤15%
Test expenses forecast: seasonal pattern data, validate MAPE ≤15%
Test cash flow forecast: volatile data with known volatility, validate MAPE threshold
Marketing spike scenario: 30% YoY increase with flat revenue → expect RISK insight
Revenue growth scenario: 15% CAGR trend → expect OPPORTUNITY insight
Seasonal pattern scenario: Q4 spike pattern → expect TREND insight
Cost overrun scenario: cloud costs 40% over budget → expect COST_REDUCTION recommendation
Growth opportunity scenario: untapped market signal → expect REVENUE_GROWTH recommendation
Generate validation report with metrics: MAPE=12.3%, Insight Relevance=78%, Alignment=85%
Test improvement recommendations: if MAPE>15%, suggest "increase historical data or tune Prophet parameters"
